text: Free tower defense demo where your whole army is chickens.
Build by day. Survive by night.
Every chicken gets a job. Shooters man the towers, looters sneak out for supplies.
Hatch eggs for stronger birds, like one called Clucky Wattleton.
Best part: the night waves get huge, with swarms and damage numbers everywhere.
The catch? The menus look like an old browser game.
The demo is about two gigs, English only.
Think Bloons TD, if the monkeys were chickens.
Worth a dip. The forest is hungry.
